'''Jumara 22 (February 9)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[1000 NE]] - Five of the [[Aes Sedai]] captured at [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] swear fealty to [[Rand]].
*[[1000 NE]] - Rand is attacked in [[Cairhien]] by [[Dashiva]], [[Charl Gedwyn|Gedwyn]], and [[Manel Rochaid|Rochaid]]. [[Fedwin Morr]] loses his sanity while protecting [[Min]] and is killed by Rand.
*[[1000 NE]] - Rand and Min leave for [[Rhuidean]] to begin leaving a false trail for the renegade [[Asha'man]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Mazrim Taim]] is summoned to [[Caemlyn]] by [[Elayne]].
